annotation_meta.instruction: Independent AI recheck from the paper only; original ground truth was not opened.

review.method_name: Kramers-Kronig receiver with digitally added carrier and digital resolution enhancer (DRE)
experimental_conditions: Experimental 64-QAM transmission at 25 GBd over 50 km standard single-mode fiber
Digitally added carrier at 13.9 GHz offset
6-bit DAC with approximately 5 effective bits at 100 GSa/s; DRE parameters M = 3 and L = 5
NGMI FEC threshold of 0.92, equivalent to a net data rate of 127 Gb/s
main_results: With a full 6-bit DAC, DRE increased NGMI by 0.013 and reduced required OSNR by 2 dB at the FEC limit
DRE enabled a 5-bit DAC with limited penalty
A 4-bit DAC with DRE matched the performance of a 6-bit DAC without DRE
